Mouse & keyboard
Left dragOrbit Right / middle dragPan WheelZoom ClickSelect (Ctrl adds) Ctrl + dragBox select (adds to selection) Double-clickFrame part — in Assembly mode, open the subassembly Axis gizmo (bottom left)Click an axis to look down it; caption shows which way is up 1 … 6 / 0Front, Back, Left, Right, Top, Bottom / Isometric Right-clickContext menu (acts on selection) — hide, isolate, paint a color… View ▸ Part colorsOne color per part or per subassembly — remembered for this assembly; the theme toggle switches the backdrop Ctrl + CCopy the selected part number(s) — the clipboard button on a list row copies that one Shift + drag partMove part / selection (the whole subassembly in Assembly mode) DMove mode — hover previews the drag target; selecting shows a move/rotate triad Triad arrows / ringsSlide / turn the selection — near the ruler snaps to steps; click one to type an exact value AAssembly mode — hover highlights a subassembly, click selects it; combine with D to drag whole subassemblies EPart edges on/off XSection view on/off MMeasure mode — click two points; corners, edges, holes and faces snap; hole readouts offer center/min/max HHide selection Shift + HUnhide the last hidden part(s) IIsolate selection OOpen the selection — view it alone; ↑ or Top asm climbs back out ↑ / ↓Up one assembly level / down one — Down heads for the selection, or back the way you came Shift + ↑ / Shift + ↓Top assembly / dive to the selection's own subassembly FFrame selection (or all) RReset appearance, positions and explode PHide / show the parts panel EscCancel a triad drag / clear selection / close ?This help
